headline: HOU @ KCR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is HOU 4.59 at KCR 3.97, with a projected total of 8.56. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward HOU: HOU moved -0.17 runs while KCR moved -0.38, changing the projected margin by +0.21 runs. The projected total fell -0.56, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -7.9%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Luinder Avila has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Vinnie Pasquantino, Jac Caglianone, Yordan Alvarez, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Tyler Tolbert, Taylor Trammell because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
